comment: seg35 label -> seg4 label of the neurite-oasis labels, read from the data, not inferred: on all 20 development subjects of stage_L2R_val_v1 every seg35 label falls in exactly one seg4 label (share 1 on every subject), seg35 = 0 exactly where seg4 = 0 (runs/20261102-a1p/seg4_label_check.json, experiments/d0/check_seg4_map.py). Used by the A1P arms (runs/20261102-a1p/plan.md) to merge the U-Net posterior of the 36 seg35 classes into the classes of A1's truth seg4. It differs from the tissue4_ref grouping of structure_groups_v1.json (status reference_unverified) on 4 labels: 6 and 25 (cerebellar cortex: subcortical gray matter here, cortex there), 17 and 33 (ventral DC: white matter here, subcortical gray matter there); tissue4_ref is not used.
